newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RAINBOW ANNOUNCES RESULTS OF RIGHTS OFFERS.
newsitem.headline: RAINBOW ANNOUNCES RESULTS OF RIGHTS OFFERS.

text.p: Rainbow Chicken's rights offer of 884,4-million convertible preference shares of 85 cents each was 74.2 percent subscribed, the company said on Friday.
The rights offers of controlling shareholders Hunt Leuchars & Hepburn Holdings Ltd and Huntcor Ltd for 121-million and 45.7-million preference shares were 99.4 percent and 98.7 percent subscribed.
